originalTitle: Equitas SFB returns to profit in Q1 as provisions fall sharply
simplifiedContent: Equitas Small Finance Bank had a good first quarter, making a profit of Rs 184 crore, which is a big improvement from the same time last year when they lost money. This happened because they didn't have to set aside as much money for potential losses, which is known as provisions. The bank also did well in other areas, such as making more money from their daily operations and having fewer bad loans. This news matters because it shows that the bank is getting healthier and stronger, which could be a good sign for investors. Overall, the bank's performance is a positive development, with increases in profits and asset growth.

originalTitle: TVS Motor Company among 9 stocks to hit 52-week highs & rally up to 15% in a month
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening: 9 big stocks, including TVS Motor Company, Bajaj Auto, and Titan, have reached their highest prices in the past year. This is notable because the overall market (measured by the Sensex) actually went down a bit on Tuesday. Despite this, investors are still buying these stocks, which means they're feeling confident about their potential. As a result, some of these stocks have gone up by as much as 15% in just a month, which is a big increase. This shows that investors are still interested in these companies, even when the rest of the market is struggling.

originalTitle: Nithin Kamath warns closing auction session may hit Zerodha’s revenue from August 3
simplifiedContent: Zerodha's CEO, Nithin Kamath, is warning that a new rule called the Closing Auction Session may decrease the company's revenue. This new rule, which starts on August 3, will change how some stocks are traded at the end of the day. The goal of the Closing Auction Session is to help figure out the fair price of stocks and reduce errors in certain types of investments. This change might make it a bit more complicated to keep track of when the market is open. The revenue decrease for Zerodha is expected to be around 1-5%, which means the company will likely earn a bit less money from trading fees.

originalTitle: Coal India Q1 capex rises 16.6% YoY to  ₹3,399 crore in, beats quarterly target
simplifiedContent: Coal India, a major coal company, spent ₹3,399 crore on new projects and investments in the first quarter of the year. This is 16.6% more than what they spent in the same period last year, and it's also more than they had planned to spend. The company put money into buying land and developing renewable energy sources, which is a significant area of investment for them. Despite having higher operating costs, the company's overall profit still managed to increase slightly. This news matters because it shows that Coal India is actively investing in its future and trying to grow its business, which could be a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Rail Vikas Nigam shares to be in focus on Wednesday as company secures a  ₹356 crore order
simplifiedContent: Rail Vikas Nigam, a company that works on railway projects, has gotten a new job worth ₹356 crore. This means they will be doing work to double some railway tracks and they have to finish it within about 2 years. The company has gotten a few big jobs recently, worth over ₹3,500 crore in total. This new job is a good thing for the company and people who own its shares might want to pay attention to what happens with the company's stock on Wednesday. The company's stock could be affected by this new development, which is why it's in focus.

originalTitle: Birlasoft Q1 Results: Net profit jumps 51% YoY to  ₹161 crore; TCV rises 20%
simplifiedContent: Birlasoft, a company, just released its quarterly results, which show that its net profit (or total earnings) increased by 51% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹161 crore. The company's revenue also grew, but only slightly, by 2.3% from the previous quarter, to ₹1,379.4 crore. The company signed new deals worth $169 million, which is 20% more than last year, indicating strong business growth. This increase in deals and profits is a positive sign for the company, and the fact that fewer employees are leaving voluntarily (11.7%) suggests that the company is doing well in retaining its staff. Overall, these results suggest that Birlasoft is performing well and growing its business.
